description: Hello #TeamCastro! We are officially in our Early Voting Era... AND have received the endorsement of Senator Jon Ossoff! I am grateful for this wonderful vote of confidence and look forward to collaborating with the Senator to serve the people of Georgia. Have you voted yet? If not, have you made a plan? Georgia needs YOU! I need you! The blue wave doesn't happen if we don't mobilize absolutely everyone. Help us make this crucial impact volunteering with us in the Get Out the Vote (GOTV) push. We need you to stay strong with us to the finish line! Reminder: Make your plan to vote today! You can check your registration, view your ballot and find your polling location here! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37
title: News from Darcy Castro
